llamavan: llamar — they were calling, knocking (imperfect 3rd pl.; = llamaban)
sopieron: saber — they learned, found out (strong preterite 3rd pl.; = supieron)
mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order')
dieron: dar — they gave (preterite 3rd pl.; dar salto 'to leap')
gradéscolo: gradecer + lo — I thank (God) for it (present 1st sg. gradesco + enclitic lo; = lo agradezco)
adobaré: adobar — I shall prepare, provide (future 1st sg.; = adobaré)
dovos: dar + vos — I give you (present 1st sg. do + enclitic vos; = os doy)
algún: alguno — some, any (apocopated before a noun; = algún)
visquiero: bivir — (if) I shall live (future subjunctive 1st sg., restored visquier[o]; = viviere)
seervos: seer + vos — to be to you (infinitive + enclitic vos, split before han: seervos han doblados = os serán doblados)
han: aver — they have (3rd pl. present); with a preceding infinitive, a split future auxiliary (= habrán)
doblados: doblar — doubled (past part. masc. pl.; = doblados)
evades: evades — behold, here you have (presentative formula; = he aquí, ahí tenéis)
çient: çient — hundred (apocopated before a noun; = cien)
ella: ella — she, her (stressed 3rd sg. fem. pronoun)
sirvádeslas: servir + las — may you serve them, you are to serve them (present subjunctive 2nd pl. used as a command, old -des ending, + enclitic las; = sirváis las)
est: este — this (apocopated masc.; est año = este año)
dues: dos — two (fem. form, dues fijas = dos hijas)
prendetlas: prender + las — take them! (imperative 2nd pl. prended, with -d- written -t- before las, + enclitic; = prendedlas)
acomiendo: acomendar — I entrust, commend (present 1st sg.; = encomiendo)
dellas: de + ellas — of them, about them (contraction, fem. pl.)
falleçiere: fallecer — (if) it should fail, run out (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = faltare)
menguare: menguar — (if) it should lack, fall short (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = menguare)
abastad: abastar — supply! provide for! (imperative 2nd pl.; = abastad)
marco: marco — mark (a unit of weight/money for silver, sg.)
despendades: despender — (that) you spend (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending; = gastéis)
otorgado: otorgar — granted, agreed to (past part.; otorgado gelo avie 'he had granted it to him'; = otorgado)
afevos: afevos — behold, here is/are (presentative, a + fe + vos; = he aquí, ahí tenéis)
do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde)
va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.); va + gerund = is (in the process of) doing
ilegando: llegar — arriving (gerund; ilegando is a misprint in Pidal for llegando)
señas: seña — one each, one apiece (fem. pl. distributive adjective, = sendas; señas dueñas 'a lady for each')
adúzenlas: aducir + las — they bring/lead them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; = las traen)
ant: ant — before, in front of (apocopated ante)
llorava: llorar — she was weeping (imperfect 3rd sg.; = lloraba)
quísol: querer + le — she wished (to) him (strong preterite 3rd sg. quiso + enclitic le reduced to l; = quiso)
merçed: merçed — mercy, favor; Merçed! 'have mercy, I beg you' (= merced)
echado: echar — cast out, exiled (past part.; = echado)
fem: fem — behold me, here I am (fe + me, presentative; = heme aquí)
ffijas: fija — daughter (pl.; variant spelling with ff of fijas; = hijas)
iffantes: infante — little ones, young children (pl.; in the poem also a noble prince)
chicas: chico — small, little (fem. pl.; de días chicas 'small in days', i.e. young; = chicas)
aquestas: aqueste — these (fem. pl. demonstrative, reinforced; = estas)
estades: estar — you are (2nd pl. present, old -ades ending; = estáis)
ida: ida — departure, going (noun; estar en ida 'to be about to depart'; = ida)
partir: partir — to part, separate (infinitive; partir nos emos 'we shall part')
dadnos: dar + nos — give us! (imperative 2nd pl. dad + enclitic nos; = dadnos)
amor: amor — love; por amor de 'for the love of'
enclinó: enclinar — he bowed, inclined (preterite 3rd sg.; = inclinó)
sues: su — his, her (fem. pl. possessive, old sue/sues; = sus)
prendía: prender — he took, grasped (imperfect 3rd sg.; = prendía)
llególas: llegar + las — he brought them close (preterite 3rd sg. llegó + enclitic las; = las llegó)
quería: querer — he/I loved, wished (imperfect 1st/3rd sg.; ca mucho las quería 'he loved them'; = quería)
mientre: mientre — adverb-forming suffix, 'in a manner' (Latin mente; fuerte mientre = fuertemente)
mie: mi — my (fem. diphthongized variant, mi[e] alma; = mi)
emos: aver — we have; with an infinitive, we shall (1st pl. present, short form of hemos; partir nos emos = nos partiremos)
fincaredes: fincar — you will remain, stay (future 2nd pl.; = quedaréis)
remanida: remanir — remaining, left behind (past part. fem.; = remanida)
plega: plazer — may it please (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; plega a Dios 'may it please God'; = plazca)
case: casar — (that) I may marry off (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = case)
quede: quedar — (that) there may remain (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quede)
fazen: fazer — they make, give (present 3rd pl.; grand yantar le fazen 'they give him a great feast'; = hacen)
tañen: tañer — they ring, toll (present 3rd pl.; = tañen)
clamor: clamor — clamor, tolling, loud peal; a clamor 'tolling loudly'
odiendo: oír — being heard (gerund, restored o[d]iendo; van odiendo 'go sounding'; = oyendo)
pregones: pregón — public proclamation, crier's announcement (pl.; = pregones)
unos: uno — some (masc. pl.; unos … otros 'some … others')
onores: onor — estate, landed property, honor (pl.; = honores)
aqués: aqueste — this (masc. demonstrative; aqués día 'that day'; = este)
juntados: juntar — gathered, assembled (past part. masc. pl.; son juntados 'have assembled'; = juntados)
demandan: demandar — they ask (for), inquire (present 3rd pl.; demandar por 'to ask after'; = demandan)
cojó: coger — he gathered, joined (preterite 3rd sg.; = cogió; con ellos cojó 'he joined them')
vansse: ir + se — they go off (present 3rd pl. van + enclitic se, spelled -ss-; = se van)
naçió: nacer — he was born (preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)

__broaden__.complida: complir — fulfilled, accomplished (past part. fem.; = cumplida) · complete, perfect, full (barba tan complida, mugier tan complida)
__broaden__.que: que — that, who, which; for · por que 'because' (mas por que me vo de tierra)
